inputs.text: The 2027 warning should be a reminder that Nigeria needs disciplined leadership, not another round of politics built on resentment toward successful people. Wealth is not the enemy; leaders fail when they use power selfishly instead of protecting families, maintaining order and serving the nation. The APC must show steady stewardship and defend the institutions that keep the country together, rather than let every accusation or fashionable grievance dictate its course.
